# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B10

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

Instrument documentation states that a positive power reading corresponds to charging power delivered to the cell.
The experiment did not acquire a power signal; measured/placeholder status is therefore undefined.
The data dictionary specifies that the discharge capacity counter resets at the beginning of every cycle.
The deposit mentions sampling of current without naming fixed-interval or event-driven rules.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

The declared unit for the current channel is mA.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Completeness of the voltage records is verified using exclusively: completeness_counter.
No test index indexing is used in this deposit, so recovery-method questions do not arise.
Within the dataset the charge/discharge state is determined by: separate_state_column.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B10 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B10.
